segments.text: Delta Fin runs Kimmy K3 2.8 trillion parameters and 1.56 tab of weights on a 64 GB MacBook. The trick is that a
mixture of experts model only touches a sliver of itself per token. So the attention spine lives on local disk and the 82,432
routed experts stay on HuggingFac's CDN fetched one HTTP range request at a time into a growing cache. It's about a token per minute. The author calls it an existence proof, not a chat setup.
